grain: one seller-branch product offer observed at one timestamp
currency_format: ISO 4217 three-letter code; Zimbabwe multi-currency offers retain the currency actually displayed
price_format: non-negative decimal in major currency units
identity_priority: supplier or manufacturer identifier under an agreement
reviewed brand plus name plus quantity plus packaging match
evidence_rules: Every observation retains seller, branch, source URL and observed_at.
Stock and price are time-varying observations, not master-product attributes.
Descriptions and images are ingested only when the feed agreement grants reuse rights.
Ambiguous text matches enter review and never become silent merges.
